partner_result_applied.application: Compared its divergent coordinatewise Renyi/Hölder surrogate on the fragmented f_N family against the new exact square-collision Riesz integral, which stays uniformly bounded by sqrt(2pi) C_sq<35.833.

mathematical_change.statement: For any real density cap M and iid X,X', E|X^2-X'^2|^{-1/2} <= C_sq M, C_sq=1+4sqrt(2)+8(log(3/2)+0.5log3)=14.295024269030135... . Hence the exact weighted independent-copy time integral of a square is uniformly bounded.
mathematical_change.corollary: For independent U,V of caps M_U,M_V, sup_z E|z-aU^2-bV^2|^{-1/2} <= C_sq sqrt(M_U M_V)|ab|^{-1/4}; one further independent square gives linear small-ball scaling.
mathematical_change.reconciliation: The earlier B03 whole-bank rank-two theorem remains valid after the newest fragmentation correction because it projects the entire cross bank before a single bilinear Plancherel estimate. Thus the two-effective-direction whole-bank endpoint is not the current analytic gap.

unresolved_implication: From s3(A)>=1 alone, force a dimension-free product-preserving alternative among a direct high-cross-rank/ridge certificate, a physical square plus quantitatively controlled whole-bank rank two, or a rank-one/star/grouped aggregation certificate. Single-pivot rank-two extraction is known false.
